items.title: Rick Margitza interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 22, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I want to read, this is connected to jazz in Europe. And it had an interview with Pierre Boussaguet and — [INTERVIEWEE] Um hum.

ctx.x: moved to Nevada. They live near Las Vegas in Henderson. And I remember finally getting the courage up to talk to them on the way to the airport. They were driving me home after Christmas and I was flying back to New York and I said, “I just got a chance to move to Paris, what do you think?” And they were both really happy. My father was like, “That would be an amazing experience for you.” So other than making it more difficult for me to get home to see them because obviously travel from Paris to Las Vegas is like…
